import re
import sys

values = {}

for statement in sys.stdin.read().split(";"):
    statement = statement.strip()
    if not statement:
        continue

    match = re.fullmatch(r"([A-Za-z_]\w*)\s*<-\s*(.+)", statement)
    if not match:
        continue

    name, expression = match.groups()
    expression = expression.strip()

    number = re.fullmatch(r"\d+", expression)
    if number:
        values[name] = int(number.group())
        continue

    update = re.fullmatch(
        r"\(\s*([A-Za-z_]\w*)\s*\+\s*(\d+)\s*\)\s*mod\s*(\d+)",
        expression,
    )
    if update:
        variable, increment, modulus = update.groups()
        values[name] = (values[variable] + int(increment)) % int(modulus)

print(
    f"a ?= {values['a']}; b ?= {values['b']}; "
    f"c ?= {values['c']}; d ?= {values['d']}; TMP ?= {values['TMP']};"
)
